predictions.rationale: Primary HTTP API controller exposing endpoints to add, remove, update items and checkout the shopping basket; directly maps to all described actions.
Implements persistence operations for CustomerBasket in Redis, enabling storage and retrieval while items are added, removed, or updated.
Domain model representing a buyer's shopping basket including items and quantities; core data structure manipulated by feature.
Provides gRPC endpoints for basket operations such as AddItem, RemoveItem, UpdateQuantity, and Checkout, directly supporting the feature.
Mobile BFF controller orchestrating basket actions for mobile clients; translates UI requests into basket service calls.
Web BFF counterpart handling basket-related HTTP requests from web SPA, forwarding add/update/remove/checkout actions.
Service used by the mobile BFF to call underlying Basket microservice; contains methods for modifying basket and initiating checkout.
Analogous service for the web BFF enabling add/remove/update and checkout operations against the Basket API.
MVC UI controller managing cart pages; invokes basket services to perform add, remove, quantity updates, and checkout actions.
Client-side service used by CartController to communicate with Basket microservice, encapsulating basket manipulation and checkout calls.
